facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on CY-3212 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on CY-3212 and PT-3212 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on CY-3212 and PT-3212 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. CY-3212 (cyclone clusters) is in service for classification duty on the grinding circuit. The task proceeded during routine operation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 8 January 2021 an incident occurred on CY-3212 and PT-3212 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
